entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnetup: Support tar.gz archives on Windows to enable hard link deduplication #54403
  • --add-source option not support on `dotnet package add` with file-based apps #54399

Closed

  • Version 10.0.1_1, 10.0.2_1 contains invalid character `_` for Debian package versioning #52602
  • [Deduplicate SDK Files] Remove special AssemblyLoadContext handling and layout logic in dotnet-watch to eliminate duplicate files #52192
  • [Deduplicate SDK Files] Utilize Windows tarballs in Official .NET Docker images #52211
  • [Deduplicate SDK Files] Investigate feasibility of preserving hard links with Windows Installers #52191
  • DefineConstants missing NET10_0_OR_GREATER on GitHub Actions #54398
  • Publishing multi-arch images depends on Docker Desktop #52634

PullRequests

Created

  • Rename ".NET installation manager" to ".NET toolchain manager" #54405
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview5] Add 'mcpserver' project template as bundled template #54404
  • fix: seperate -> separate typo (#54379) #54402
  • Add AI-powered build failure analysis agentic workflow #54401
  • Backport gzip I/O retry logic and redirected-input console guard to release/10.0.4xx #54400
  • File-based apps: ensure shebang analyzer only applies to `#:include` #54397
    Area-run-file
  • File-based apps: support `#:include .dll` by default #54396
    Area-run-file
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.4xx' => 'main' #54395

Merged

  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54320
  • Add 'mcpserver' project template as bundled template #54132
    Area-Templates
  • allow SB SDKs to emit otel telemetry like MS-built SDKs do #54328
    Area-Telemetry
  • Remove suggestion for docs-only build analysis bypass in developer guide #54383
  • Fix parallel-build race condition on RunnableProjects DLL #54380
  • File-based apps: handle conversion of custom included item types #54251
    Area-run-file

Updated

  • `dotnetup` verifies release signatures #54300
  • Add `dotnet test` device selection support for MAUI #54295
  • Add explicit migration support to dotnetup install #53909
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54367
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add AOT tests for NativeAOT CLI entry point #54297
  • Enable 'dotnet sdk check' command in AOT native binary #54391
    Area-CLI
  • Fix DefaultVerificationExcludePatterns to use ** for recursive matching #54390
  • Allow some duplicate #: directives #54206
    Area-run-file
  • Add AOT support for dotnet sln list, migrate, and remove #54384
    Area-CLI
  • Convert dotnet-format integration tests from pipeline YAML to XUnit/Helix #54231
  • Use Process.StartAndForget for fire-and-forget process launches #54093
  • Use templating for NetAnalyzers SARIF SDK version #54027
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix arm64 macOS CI installing x64 runtimes under Rosetta 2 #54253
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Honor standard OpenTelemetry OTLP env vars for exporter enablement #54386
  • Add NETSDK1234 warning for macOS apps with .App or .Service suffix #51441
  • Fix `seperate` typo #54379
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Migrate ResolveOverlappingItemGroupConflicts and ResolvePublicOutputConflicts to MT #54355
  • Detect VS Code Copilot terminal via `COPILOT_AGENT` in LLM telemetry detection #54358
    Area-Telemetry
  • Migrate GenerateDepsFile to IMultiThreadableTask #53950
  • Add escape hatch for PublishRuntimeIdentifier being appended to RuntimeIdentifiers by default #54291
  • Fix dotnet test crash on empty, invalid, or unreadable global.json #52386
